project_music_style: Sparse low strings and restrained pulse motifs that can be mistaken for a muffled watch-tick; avoid lush romantic score; prioritize silence and diegetic creaks.

scenes.score_intent: Barely-there drone under confessional VO; no melody that comforts.
scenes.timing: Enter under first VO; thin out before chamber montage.
scenes.silence_guidance: Leave air around claims of calm so nervousness reads.
scenes.source_evidence: I heard all things in the heaven and in the earth.

scenes.score_intent: Repeating soft nocturnal figure; cut hard on morning greetings.
scenes.timing: Pulse only during midnight approaches; mute on daytime kindness.
scenes.silence_guidance: Long held quiet while head enters the room.
exclusions: no jump-scare stingers on closed eye
scenes.source_evidence: I undid the lantern cautiously—oh, so cautiously—cautiously (for the hinges creaked)

scenes.score_intent: Withdraw score as diegetic heart-sound becomes lead percussion.
scenes.timing: After eye ray, introduce low dull quick beat; accelerate to yell.
scenes.silence_guidance: Full hour stillness after Who’s there?—hold muscle-quiet.
scenes.source_evidence: there came to my ears a low, dull, quick sound, such as a watch makes when enveloped in cotton.

scenes.score_intent: Dry, workmanlike absence of triumph music; silence as cunning.
scenes.timing: Optional faint low tone under dismemberment; cut for plank work.
scenes.silence_guidance: Work hastily but in silence—keep foley tight and hushed.
exclusions: no comic tub sting beyond narrator’s ha! ha! if VO used
no explicit gore wet mix beyond source necessity
scenes.source_evidence: I worked hastily, but in silence.

scenes.score_intent: Pleasant neutral bed under officers replaced by rising non-diegetic/diegetic ambiguous heartbeat only narrator seems to hear.
scenes.timing: Heart re-enters after chat establishes ease; climb under pacing and chair grating to confession.
diegetic_sound: pleasant officer chat murmur without invented lines
final shrieked confession lines from source
scenes.silence_guidance: Officers remain aurally calm; do not let them acknowledge the heart until confession.
exclusions: no officer accusation lines not in source
scenes.source_evidence: It was a low, dull, quick sound—much such a sound as a watch makes when enveloped in cotton. I gasped for breath—and yet the officers heard it not.
